question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
answer:
Delivery did far better than the counter last week (Monday Oct 12 through Sunday Oct 18, local time, completed orders only).

Delivery had 883 orders and $28,221.43 in gross sales. That's about $31.96 per order, and $30,037.70 once tax and tips are added. In-store orders at the counter came to 102 orders and $2,307.93 in gross sales, about $22.63 per order, with $2,575.10 collected in total. So delivery brought in roughly 12 times the counter's sales, and its average order was about $9 bigger. Discounts were $1,264.85 on delivery and $110.62 at the counter.

Tips are hard to compare because most orders don't report them. Only 63 of the 883 delivery orders had tip data, averaging $5.05, and only 47 of the 102 counter orders did, averaging $3.25.

Pickup orders aren't included in either number. They were 948 orders and $25,361.12 in gross sales, so they made up a large share of the week too.

detail.purpose: Compare delivery vs in-store (counter) completed orders and sales for last week (Mon Oct 12 – Sun Oct 18, 2026, local time)
detail.sql: SELECT fulfillment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents, SUM(total_cents) AS total_cents, ROUND(AVG(gross_sales_cents)) AS avg_gross_cents, ROUND(AVG(tip_cents)) AS avg_tip_cents, COUNT(tip_cents) AS orders_with_tip_data FROM orders WHERE state = 'completed' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants)) >= '2026-10-12' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants)) < '2026-10-19' GROUP BY fulfillment_type ORDER BY fulfillment_type

SELECT fulfillment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents, SUM(total_cents) AS total_cents, ROUND(AVG(gross_sales_cents)) AS avg_gross_cents, ROUND(AVG(tip_cents)) AS avg_tip_cents, COUNT(tip_cents) AS orders_with_tip_data FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS orders WHERE state = 'completed' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) >= '2026-10-12' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) < '2026-10-19' GROUP BY fulfillment_type ORDER BY fulfillment_type LIMIT 500
